scope: Assertion-intent crosswalk for the actual csdid DR / normalized-IPW / regression dispatch, not a claim that the entire DRDID API is ported.

status_definitions.covered: All identified applicable numerical/public intents have explicit Python checks; excluded R-only contracts are listed.
status_definitions.partial: Some applicable assertions are covered and remaining gaps are named.
status_definitions.not applicable: The tested R estimator/API is not dispatched by csdid, or deliberately has a different public contract. Related Python tests may still be listed.
status_definitions.gap: No applicable counterpart exists; never inferred from a filename alone.

unsupported: improved/IPT estimators and IPT solver internals
R S3 output methods and wrapper-only binary-dname rules

validation.latest_result: 587 targeted tests passed, including 152 alignment cases and existing aggregation regressions; all four affected current-R varying-weight cases also passed.

R non-normalized-IPW closed forms were not reused for normalized IPW; only their independent empirical-derivative and mass-invariance strategy was reused.
